messages.text: Hello, I sent back the face cream set, it gave me a rash. Can I have a refund?

tool_calls.name: lookup_refund_policy
tool_calls.arguments: {"query":"refund request where the product caused a rash or other adverse reaction; whether this is covered or requires staff review"}

messages.name: lookup_refund_policy
messages.content: {"ok": true, "sections": [{"citation": "refund-policy/v1/scope", "title": "What this policy covers", "text": "This policy covers refunds for items in orders that the signed-in customer placed with the demo shop. All amounts are in BRL, and all times are the shop's clock in UTC. The shop and this policy are fictional: this is a demonstration, not the policy of any real shop and not legal advice."}, {"citation": "refund-policy/v1/window", "title": "Time limit", "text": "A refund must be requested no later than 30 days after the delivery time recorded on the order. If an earlier proposal for the same items was created in time but expired or stopped being valid before it was paid, a later request is not refused for being late: a staff member takes the case."}, {"citation": "refund-policy/v1/exceptions", "title": "Exceptions and talking to a person", "text": "Anything this policy does not cover, and any request for an exception, goes to a staff member.
